decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.976. Series context: trend strength 0.9383 and seasonal strength 0.2168; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.002); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.424.
